data.abstract: The dataset includes 244 instances that regroup a data of two regions of Algeria.

intro_paper.title: Predicting Forest Fire in Algeria Using Data Mining Techniques: Case Study of the Decision Tree Algorithm
intro_paper.venue: Ezziyyani M. (eds) Advanced Intelligent Systems for Sustainable Development (AI2SD’2019). Advances in Intelligent Systems and Computing

additional_info.summary:
The dataset includes 244 instances that regroup a data of two regions of Algeria,namely the Bejaia region located in the northeast of Algeria and the Sidi Bel-abbes region located in the northwest of Algeria.

122 instances for each region. 

The period from June 2012 to September 2012. 
The dataset includes 11 attribues and 1 output attribue (class)
